repos_data.description: Milvus is a high-performance, cloud-native vector database built for scalable vector ANN search
Qdrant - High-performance, massive-scale Vector Database and Vector Search Engine for the next generation of AI. Also available in the cloud https://cloud.qdrant.io/

Weaviate is an open-source vector database that stores both objects and vectors, allowing for the combination of vector search with structured filtering with the fault tolerance and scalability of a cloud-native database​.
💡 All-in-one AI framework for semantic search, LLM orchestration and language model workflows
The AI-native database built for LLM applications, providing incredibly fast hybrid search of dense vector, sparse vector, tensor (multi-vector), and full-text.
Fast Open-Source Search & Clustering engine × for Vectors & Arbitrary Objects × in C++, C, Python, JavaScript, Rust, Java, Objective-C, Swift, C#, GoLang, and Wolfram 🔍
Open-source tools for prompt testing and experimentation, with support for both LLMs (e.g. OpenAI, LLaMA) and vector databases (e.g. Chroma, Weaviate, LanceDB).

SIMD-accelerated distances, dot products, matrix ops, geospatial & geometric kernels for 16 numeric types — from 6-bit floats to 64-bit complex — across x86, Arm, RISC-V, and WASM, with bindings for Python, Rust, C, C++, Swift, JS, and Go 📐
MemFree - Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator
Embeddable vector database for Go with Chroma-like interface and zero third-party dependencies. In-memory with optional persistence.
An official lightweight library for the RaBitQ algorithm and its applications in vector search.
Persistent session memory for AI coding agents — local-first, with on-device inference, associative recall, and drift detection. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
🧠 LLM-Driven Intelligent Memory & Context Management System （AI记忆管理与智能上下文感知平台） AI记忆管理平台 | 智能上下文感知 | RAG检索增强生成  | 向量检索引擎
Natural Context Provider (NCP). Your MCPs, supercharged. Find any tool instantly, load on demand, run on schedule, ready for any   client. Smart loading saves tokens and energy.
CLI + Local MCP - A shared structured memory store across Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, and every MCP client. Semantically queryable.
Convert source code to LLM ready knowledge base

Embedded long-term memory database for AI agents & LLM apps. Six-layer cognitive architecture, knowledge graph, hybrid BM25 + vector search, sleep-time memory consolidation. One .meh file, zero infrastructure, pure Go.

NEXO Brain — Shared brain for AI agents. Persistent memory, semantic RAG, natural forgetting, metacognitive guard, trust scoring, 150+ MCP tools. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Claude Desktop & any MCP client. 100% local, open source, free.
✈️ 24-tool MCP server for Claude Code: preflight checks for your prompts, cross-service context, session history search with LanceDB vectors, correction pattern learning, cost estimation

MCP server with 39 tools for web design analysis — layout extraction, motion detection, quality scoring, accessibility audit, Core Web Vitals, design comparison, and semantic search via Playwright, pgvector, ONNX Runtime, and Ollama.
Production-grade persistent memory service for AI agents — FastAPI + pgvector + local ONNX embeddings
